assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production enemy animation sprite atlas for Infernal City. Create ONE new raster PNG atlas, wide 2:1 canvas, target 2048×1024, genuine transparent RGBA background. Exactly 8 equal-width columns × 4 equal-height rows, 32 distinct animation frames, no gutters or drawn grid. Each invisible cell contains exactly one creature pose centered on the same pivot, with at least 15% completely transparent padding on ALL FOUR sides, including effects, weapons and fragments. Maximum pose extent is 68% of cell width and 68% of cell height. Camera fixed three-quarter game view, facing slightly toward the lower-right, no camera turns, fixed scale and anchor across frames. Painterly high-detail 2.5D fantasy science-fiction rendering matching the provided project's material and light treatment, readable clean silhouettes; no pixel art. The input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 supplies materials/ornament, image 2 shading/detail/energy design, image 3 faction palette and atmosphere. Do not reproduce their structures or layouts. This is the first visual design for a named enemy in the Bible; preserve this new creature identity consistently in every frame. Row 1 is MOVE: 8 unique smooth movement/swim/hover cycle poses with meaningful limb/wing/appendage changes, first and last adjacent phases but not duplicates. Row 2 is ATTACK: 8 unique phases of anticipation, wind-up, strike/emission, follow-through, recovery. Row 3 is DEATH_DISSOLVE: 8 unique stages from intact struck pose through collapse, material fragmentation and nearly vanished dust; final frame retains a few visible motes. Row 4 is SHIELD_BREAK: 8 unique intact-creature recoil poses with a thin faction-colored energy shell cracking progressively and breaking into small shards, then a clear recovered final pose. Shield/effects must not obscure the body. No injury/gore. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, cell borders, checkerboard, black/white backdrop, floor, scenery, drop shadow or watermark. Every cell uses empty alpha outside the subject; no bloom across cell boundaries.
Subject: Chérubin Automaton. A small threatening winged clockwork automaton shaped as a compact porcelain and white-marble celestial sentinel, ornate gold mechanical feather wings, indigo joint cavities, one bright cyan lens within a smooth mask, tiny articulated armored limbs. This is an entirely mechanical construct, no human child or skin. Angular guardian silhouette with mechanical wings. Attack launches a little cyan solar dart. Death separates clockwork feathers and dissolves into restrained gold motes.
Color palette: White alabaster #fef3c7, polished gold #f59e0b, deep indigo #312e81, cyan energy #38bdf8.
